ModMetaData.name: 装备精神能力读档修复 / Equippable Psycast Load Fix
ModMetaData.author: WhiteGiverMa
ModMetaData.description:
修复读档时 `Constructor on type 'RimWorld.Psycast' not found` 红字。原版 CompEquippableAbility 在存档时用无参构造恢复装备附带的能力，而 Psycast 只有 (Pawn) 与 (Pawn, AbilityDef) 构造；凡是以 Psycast 作为装备能力的 mod（例如 The Dead Man's Switch - Taktikmagier 的扫帚飞行）都会在读档时报错并丢失该能力的冷却/充能状态。本补丁只在该能力类型没有无参构造时补上匹配的构造参数，其他装备能力仍走原版路径。
Fixes the red error "Constructor on type 'RimWorld.Psycast' not found" when loading a save. Vanilla CompEquippableAbility restores an equipment-granted ability with a parameterless constructor, but Psycast only has (Pawn) and (Pawn, AbilityDef); any mod that grants a Psycast through an equippable (e.g. broom flight from The Dead Man's Switch - Taktikmagier) fails to load it and resets its cooldown/charges. This patch supplies the matching constructor arguments only when the ability class has no parameterless constructor; other equippable abilities keep the vanilla path.
